**Backlog ID:** A00 | **Priority:** P0 | **Workstream:** foundation | **Delivery milestone:** M0

## User story
As the PoC developer, I want to validate the voice and coding integrations before implementation so that the architecture relies on capabilities that actually work.

## Description
Exercise a minimal VS Code Webview microphone/realtime connection and the chosen coding backend. Record platform permissions, authentication/billing assumptions, and actual start, steer, cancel and optional resume behavior.

## Business value
Retires the largest integration risks before investing in the extension and prevents promises the backend cannot keep.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] An explicit user action starts microphone capture in the extension development host; ending the probe releases it.
- [ ] A real provider session demonstrates two-way audio and records observed limits on recognition during playback.
- [ ] A minimal coding run demonstrates start, status, steering and cancellation, or records unsupported operations and a tested cancel/restart fallback.
- [ ] Findings name the tested provider/backend, authentication model, OS/editor versions, failures and recommended integration path.

## Dependencies
- None (first architecture spike).

Native GitHub blocked-by relationships mirror the prerequisite IDs above. Dependency completion is a scheduling gate, not proof this story is complete.

**4 engineering hours** for one experienced TypeScript developer; rough estimate, excluding environment/debugging contingency. Integration uncertainty may increase effort. **Size: S** under the working convention S ≤4h, M 5–6h, L 7–8h; not story points. P0 is PoC-critical; P1 is optional.

As a developer, I want explicit listening and recording controls and safe data handling so that my conversation and credentials remain under my control.

Makes dogfooding safe and avoids hidden capture or accidental credential disclosure.

As the PoC owner, I want repeatable end-to-end evaluation so that I can decide whether Piarre is ready for broader MVP testing.

## Description

## Business value
Establishes measurable product quality and a focused path from PoC to MVP.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Complete 15–20 website-building sessions, including clarification, approval, live rationale, mid-build dark-mode change, preview feedback, recap and restart.
- [ ] Run and record all regression scenarios T01–T12; each failure includes expected/observed behavior, root-cause category, severity, fix and linked regression.
- [ ] Report observed acknowledgment latency (target median <1.5s on stable network), routing ≥95%, build success ≥90%, fact accuracy ≥95%, recovery ≥90%, and zero unapproved destructive operations.
- [ ] Record actual token/audio costs and sample counts; PoC sign-off requires repeatable golden-path success, T01–T12 passing and evidence-matching summaries.
